case_studies.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
case_studies.abstract: Business intelligence (BI) is a cornerstone of enterprise decision-making and is widely used by enterprise users in software such as Power BI and Tableau. In traditional BI workflows, users need to prepare data by (1) identifying relevant tables, (2) performing data transformations, and (3) building join relationships, before they can (4) answer their business questions. These steps can be complex and time-consuming, making BI challenging. case_studies.summary: BI‑Agent uses large language models to automatically identify tables, transform data, and build joins needed to answer business questions, eliminating the manual steps in traditional BI. The authors created a benchmark (BI‑Bench) to evaluate such systems, showing that LLM‑driven workflows can match or exceed human performance on common BI tasks. This shows a way to reduce data‑prep effort in BI tools like Power BI and Tableau.
case_studies.it_breakdown: If you manage cloud data services, here is what to do: 1) check if your BI platform can integrate LLM APIs for automated table discovery and transformations; 2) pilot the LLM‑driven workflow on a small dataset to gauge accuracy; 3) monitor performance and adjust compute resources to handle the extra inference load.
case_studies.score_reasoning: The paper proposes using LLMs to automate the entire BI workflow, which is a novel idea that could interest IT engineers who manage Power BI/Tableau. The approach is directly relevant to BI tooling and could influence how data pipelines and dashboards are built, but the paper does not provide a ready‑to‑deploy solution, so its immediate value for building or automating systems within 90 days is limited.
